parameters.query:
-- Weekly Sales Performance KPIs
SELECT 
  -- Lead Volume
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as leads_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as leads_last_week,
  
  -- Qualification Metrics
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE qualification_status = 'QUALIFIED' AND qualified_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as qualified_this_week,
  ROUND(AVG(composite_score) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'), 1) as avg_lead_score,
  
  -- Pipeline by Temperature
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lead_temperature = 'Hot' AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED_WON','CLOSED_LOST')) as hot_leads_active,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lead_temperature = 'Warm' AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED_WON','CLOSED_LOST')) as warm_leads_active,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lead_temperature = 'Cold' AND status NOT IN ('CLOSED_WON','CLOSED_LOST')) as cold_leads_active,
  
  -- Conversions
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED_WON' AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as closed_won_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CLOSED_LOST' AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as closed_lost_this_week,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PROPOSAL_SENT' AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as proposals_sent_this_week,
  
  -- Revenue Estimates
  ROUND(AVG(deal_probability_percent) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('CLOSED_WON','CLOSED_LOST')), 1) as avg_win_probability,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_deal_size = 'Enterprise') as enterprise_deals,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_deal_size = 'Large') as large_deals,
  
  -- Source Attribution
  MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY source) as top_lead_source

FROM leads

SELECT 
  r.full_name,
  r.tier_level,
  COUNT(l.id) as total_assigned,
  COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'CLOSED_WON') as closed_won,
  COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'PROPOSAL_SENT') as proposals_out,
  ROUND(AVG(l.composite_score), 0) as avg_lead_quality,
  ROUND(COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'CLOSED_WON')::decimal / NULLIF(COUNT(l.id),0) * 100, 1) as win_rate_percent
FROM sales_reps r
LEFT JOIN leads l ON l.assigned_rep = r.rep_id 
  AND l.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
WHERE r.is_active = true
GROUP BY r.id, r.full_name, r.tier_level
ORDER BY closed_won DESC, win_rate_percent DESC

Format: Use HTML with professional styling, data tables, color-coded performance indicators.
